newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end down as profit taking continues.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end down as profit taking continues.

text.p: Investors booked profit on a wide range of scrips for a second straight session pushing Dhaka stocks sharply down at close, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) ended 93.51 or 3.95 percent down at 2,269.01 on a turnover of 53.3 million taka. Of 78 traded issues, 62 lost, 14 gained and 2 flat.

"Market now behaves normal. Prices shot up last week and now investors are yielding profit," said one broker. An analyst said market correction was yet to end. Stocks faced deep corrction throughout the December following months of lingering rally. AMCL Pran lost 185 taka to 1,726 and Monno Fabrics shed 25 to 225.
